scope: Data storage for disposable PostgreSQL containers in the registered native release matrix.
observations: The container configuration contains the exact registered mount.
Inside the running container, stat reports the registered filesystem at the data directory.
retained: Server images, versions, language profiles and external reference interpretation
Per-statement deadlines and per-domain execution budgets
Catalog, transactional effects and rollback observations
Fixture, case, refusal, comparison and fault inventories
durability: Crash and power-loss durability are outside the observed domain. Each container and its fixture data are disposable.
